rows.title: $700M short-term credit facility from IDB Invest (approved in August 2026)
rows.detail: POSCO HOLDINGS' 10-14-2026 release on its second Argentina brine lithium plant states that in August it secured approval for a $700 million short-term credit facility from IDB Invest (Inter-American Investment Corporation); the exact approval day is not stated, so the row is dated the disclosing release.
